rules: Every mask must cite its ledger row (spec 08 §5.2, branch research/spec-content-boundary: 'no ledger line, no mask'). Classes: M1 dynamic zone (e.g. carousel frame, badge counts), M2 content-repair zone (spec 08 §3: PDP Design intent / Where-works / FAQ / Material route, fact-fix lines), M3 upgrade zone (ledger L-row named upgrade items). Masks with class M2 may carry geometry assertions (spec 08 §3.2 track (a)).

schema.viewports: optional array, subset of ['1440','390']; required for rect masks
schema.selector: CSS selector measured in the local DOM into document coordinates (preferred)
schema.rect: [x, y, w, h] in document coordinates, when no local element exists (viewport-specific)
schema.ledger: the ledger row that authorizes this mask (spec 08 §2.2 L-row / D-decision / fact-fixes line)
schema.geometry: M2 only: array of block assertions, in expected block order; each entry: {selector, x:[min,max], y:[min,max], width:[min,max], height:[min,max], fontSize:[minPx,maxPx], lineHeight:[minPx,maxPx], fontFamily:'expected substring'} — every field optional, numbers inclusive
